title: Workflow-transfer benchmark of optical surface-roughness measurements against an internal tactile baseline across engineering materials and manufacturing processes
description: Reproducibility package for a retrospective benchmark of optical surface roughness workflows against an internal tactile baseline across multiple engineering materials and surface-generation processes. The public package contains scripts, configuration files, manuscript and supplement sources, derived CSV outputs, generated tables, generated figures, Rsm diagnostic and unit-scale sensitivity outputs, bootstrap stability summaries, and an R environment snapshot. Raw .sur surface files are excluded from the public repository and are available from the authors on reasonable request, subject to data-transfer constraints.
notes: Raw .sur/.SUR surface files are intentionally excluded from the public GitHub-Zenodo release. Derived CSV outputs, generated manuscript tables, generated figures, Rsm diagnostic and unit-scale sensitivity outputs, bootstrap stability summaries, the R environment snapshot, and rebuild scripts are included.
